hotspots.title: Krakow Mass Shooting & Far-Right Suspect
hotspots.blurb: Public outrage and intense political recriminations continue following the mass shooting in Krakow that killed six people. Polish leaders, including President Karol Nawrocki and Prime Minister Donald Tusk, joined silent marches while opposition PiS politicians and the government clashed sharply over the suspect's motives, police response, and political accountability after the shooter died in custody.
hotspots.affect: Disproportionate attention driven by high-fatality grief, grief-fueled anger, and aggressive partisan blame-shifting over ideological violence and security failures.

hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Fallout from the Republican midterm defeats has triggered intense infighting within the MAGA movement, highlighted by Rep. Thomas Massie filing articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Simultaneously, Stephen Miller's promotion to chief of staff and JD Vance's controversial post-election remarks have deepened intra-party recriminations over Trump-era governance and foreign policy.
hotspots.affect: Fueled by high affective investment around intra-movement betrayal, congressional impeachment warfare, and frantic post-election blame assignment.

hotspots.title: Pope Leo XIV & Javier Milei Dueling Visions Clash
hotspots.blurb: Pope Leo XIV's visit to Argentina created sharp ideological friction as the pontiff delivered public homilies defending social welfare and warning that economic power has limits. While President Javier Milei and his cabinet maintained formal diplomatic protocol, local and international commentary focused heavily on the stark moral contrast between papal social doctrine and Milei's libertarian austerity measures.
hotspots.affect: Commands heavy focus due to the moral charge of a global religious leader directly challenging a right-wing government's economic agenda on its home turf.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Tensions remain high in Brazil following the electoral defeat of the Bolsonarista camp, with Flávio Bolsonaro admitting a lack of evidence for fraud while residing in the US. In Brasilia, intense congressional friction has erupted over potential amnesty legislation for Jair Bolsonaro, triggering furious resistance from government allies and ethics investigations.
hotspots.affect: Charged by grievance over lost executive power, allegations of election integrity sabotage, and contentious battles over legal prosecution versus political pardon.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats Drop Cabinet Demand
hotspots.blurb: Debate over Sweden's governing bloc persists following the Sweden Democrats' announcement that they are dropping their demand for formal cabinet posts in a future administration. Social Democrat opposition leader Magdalena Andersson and right-wing coalition figures have engaged in heated public exchanges over party tactics and the scope of SD's underlying political influence.
hotspots.affect: Sustained by strategic anxiety, ongoing debate over far-right mainstreaming, and partisan posturing over coalition power dynamics.
